author: paulg
text:
BREAKING: Pod 6 is live.

The sixth generation of our intelligent sleep system, redesigned for every kind of bed.

✅ The new Hub is small enough to fit under your bed frame
✅ More powerful than ever
✅ With 9x more sensors for enhanced accuracy
✅ In new Solo sizes, at our lowest starting price yet

This is our most significant hardware launch to date, and our most accessible.

Available now at http://eightsleep.com
